fr.title: Surface
fr.description: Regroupe un contenu sur un fond surélevé, ombré et aux coins continus : la base des cartes, des groupes de lignes et des alertes.
notFor: fenêtre par-dessus la page : utiliser un dialogue (dialog)

changelog: A surface adjusts without touching the theme: `radius` (continuous corners), `color` (the background instead of the variant's, the shadow staying the variant's), `gradient` (painted on the background, clipped to the shape) and `outlined` (a `border` stroke of `size.border`, whatever the variant). The default rendering does not change.
